jobs.title: Associate Scientist II, Research
jobs.description_text:
Join our Mission to Protect Humankind!

Vaxcyte is a clinical-stage vaccine innovation company engineering high-fidelity vaccines to protect humankind from the consequences of bacterial diseases, which have serious and costly health consequences when left unchecked. Working to eradicate or treat bacterial infections such as invasive pneumococcal disease, Group A Strep, and Shigella is just the beginning. Our path to success is clear and well-defined, and Vaxcyte is set up to go the distance. 
 
WHAT we do is every bit as important as HOW we do it! Our work together is guided by four enduring core values:
 
*RETHINK CONVENTION: We bring creative and intellectual diversity to every facet of the work we do in order to innovate and re-innovate the way vaccines are delivered.
 
*AIM HIGH: We embody our collectively audacious goal to courageously make the most complex biologics ever attempted to protect humankind.
 
*LEAD WITH HEART: Everyone leads at Vaxcyte with a kindness-first, inclusive approach to collaboration and vigorous debate that advances our business objectives.
 
*MODEL EXCELLENCE:  The magnitude of our challenge requires our shared commitment to demonstrating integrity, accountability, equality and clarity across co

jobs.title: Inventory Control Specialist | Dallas, TX
jobs.description_text:
Vixxo is seeking a full-time Inventory and Control Logistics Specialist to manage a territory in person, including Dallas, TX, and the surrounding areas. Compensation ranges from $ 23/h to $ 25/h, depending on experience.

THE ROLE:

As an Inventory and Control Logistics Specialist, you will work independently to provide outstanding customer service by ensuring timely deliveries, accurate inventory audits, and professional interactions throughout your assigned territory.

WHO WILL LOVE THIS JOB:

  • A reliable operator: You are dependable with deadlines and work through challenges that may impact timely service calmly, coolly, and collectedly by finding ways to meet your service delivery goals.
  • A clear communicator: You are customer-focused and can explain technical concepts clearly and effectively to non-technical individuals.
  • A constant learner: You are unafraid to ask questions and constantly strive to refine your technical expertise.

TOP RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Complete assigned delivery work, including driving a company vehicle, and arrive home safely at the end of your workday.
  • Manage the sorting, cycle counts, and delivery of inventory per established customer guidelines from a secured facility and/or to various client locations.
  • Build strong relationships

jobs.title: Senior Facilities Coordinator
jobs.description_text:
Vixxo wants your ambition, your experience, your talent, and what makes you unique. We may have a place for you on one of our many teams, all dedicated to facilities management for some of your favorite retail, grocery, restaurant, and convenience store brands. We work hard at growing our corporate culture, which includes Vixxo commitment to diversity through valuing differences.

Vixxo is seeking a full-time Senior Facilities Coordinator to be based in our Colwich, KS office.

Shift: Monday/Tuesday OFF, Wednesday/Thursday 1p-10p, Friday 5p-8p, Sat/Sun 9a-730p

THE ROLE :

The Senior Facilities Coordinator is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, control, and completion of assigned work requests, ensuring consistency with company and customer contract terms.  

TOP RESPONSIBILITIES :

  • Receive and organize work requests from clients. This will primarily include core business trades including handyman, electrical, plumbing, and HVAC.
  • Make contractor assignments using the CWFS contractor base.  Escalate any work with costs exceeding $1500 to the manager for further direction.
  • Ensures the contractor selected meets predetermined client and manager-directed rates and SLAs.

jobs.title: Construction Management Internship – Spring 2027
jobs.description_text:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.  

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.  

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda

jobs.description_text: Company Description At Alertus, protecting people from harm is our mission and our passion. As the leader in mass notification, we are committed to providing customizable, scalable, and cost-effective solutions, as we know even a few seconds of warning can help save lives during an emergency. Our employees are integral to the company’s success and impact countless people's lives, safety, and well-being. We aim for a positive, collaborative environment that allows employees to work across departments easily and effectively. Job Description The Account Managers are responsible for working directly with our customers to ensure full, continuous satisfaction with our solutions and services are met. The Account Manager’s ultimate goals are to drive customer engagement and readiness of our solutions in times of crisis. Their engagement activities are responsible for building strong customer relationships that promote customer retention as well as ensuring customers are aware of opportunities to better complete their unified notification solutions with simple, easy-to-deploy automated crisis response tools they may not yet have. The ideal candidate will possess strong communication and organizational skills. They will need a strong technical understanding of our products’ current capabilities and the drive to find out more about our customers’ needs to ensure that our solutions are meeting their expectations to the fullest. jobs.title: Robot Operator/Technician (Hammond, LA)
jobs.description_text: We are a fast-paced Series A startup growing our team of dynamic builders, tech-enthusiasts, and compassionate professionals on a mission to deploy AI-powered robotic solutions that make supply chain operations more human-friendly and efficient. Ambi Robotics is excited to add a temporary part-time Robot Operator/Technician to the team. We are looking for an individual who will be responsible for operating our AmbiStack systems at a critical customer site during a six-month evaluation period. This role serves the customer as the primary point of contact for field issues with robotic equipment, supports system installations, coordinates with remote engineers for debugging and improvements, operates forklifts safely and efficiently, and collaborates with the Ambi Engineering team to enhance the product. The ideal candidate is customer-obsessed, and goes above and beyond to exceed expectations. Installation begins 11/10/25 and project is expected to be completed 06/30/2026.

jobs.title: Care Manager, Michigan
jobs.description_text: The Care Manager will work with primary care practices as a part of the Provider Delivered Care Management Program (PDCMP). The Care Manager collaborates with the care team within each practice and leverages Aledade’s interdisciplinary care team to provide telephone-based health coaching, quality improvement, and care coordination. The Care Manager works closely with patients to support them in becoming active in their health care by better understanding their chronic conditions, helping them access care in the most appropriate setting, and improving quality of care. Care Managers utilize Aledade’s proprietary population health tool, the “Aledade App” to manage high-risk patients, using real-time data to identify and intervene on high utilizers who could benefit from more preventative and active management. Location Requirement: This is a remote role within Michigan. Candidates must be based in the state of Michigan to be considered. Salary Range: $70,000 to $87,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Remote
jobs.description_text: The Executive Assistant (EA) serves as a strategic executive business partner supporting 3-4 assigned senior leadership members (SVPs+). Moving beyond traditional administrative support, the EA leverages organizational insight to optimize executive efficacy, proactively mitigate operational risks, and streamline cross-functional workflows. Operating in a fast-paced environment, this role acts as a trusted gatekeeper and operational liaison, ensuring leadership focus remains strictly aligned with company priorities.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Enterprise Partnerships, Minnesota
jobs.description_text: Executive Directors, Enterprise Partnerships are the business leads for large, strategic hospital and health system accounts. They act as a link between the field and Aledade Centralized support teams, focusing on ACO-specific business operations. Executive Directors partner with Medical Directors to align clinical initiatives with savings goals and provide the business case and direction for field team practice interactions. The Executive Director, Enterprise Partnerships, will be pivotal in building Aledade’s service model in the Minnesota market and beyond for a core group of strategic partners.

jobs.title: Michigan Payer Enrollment Operations Manager, Remote
jobs.description_text: Join a leadership team where your work directly shapes how Aledade’s physician practices succeed in value-based care. As Michigan Payer Enrollment Operations Manager (internally: Operations Manager, IPA), you’ll partner with IPA leadership to oversee the administrative engine behind our contracts, including payer contracts, contract membership, payment distribution, and client services delivery. You’ll collaborate across internal departments to help clients get the most out of pay-for-performance programs, risk sharing arrangements, and value-based contracts, and you’ll lead a team that may include an Operations Specialist and Membership Associates. Location Note: This is a remote role, with a strong preference for candidates based in Michigan due to the importance of understanding the state’s payer landscape and programs. Candidates located anywhere within the US will be considered. Salary Range: $90,000—$110,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: National Medical Director, Enterprise Partnerships, Remote
jobs.description_text: The National Medical Director leads and develops a team of Medical Directors and Clinical Directors responsible for clinical strategy across the Enterprise book of business. This role is accountable for the performance, growth, and coordination of that team — setting priorities, allocating clinical resources across portfolios, and ensuring consistent execution of Aledade's programs and technologies across ACOs. In addition to owning individual strategic market relationships directly, this leader builds the team's capability to develop and sustain relationships, influence clinical workflows, and drive value-based healthcare outcomes. This role requires demonstrated excellence in leading and coaching physician leaders, and in creating buy-in with internal and external stakeholders to promote and affect change in how healthcare is delivered.

jobs.title: Outreach Specialist, CACP
jobs.description_text: The CACP Outreach Specialist is the first step in the patient journey and supports the Comprehensive Advance Care Planning (CACP) program through high-volume inbound and outbound outreach. The role primarily manages outbound scheduling and inbound inquiries; educates patients about CACP; addresses reluctance with empathy and professionalism; and schedules facilitation appointments. The specialist follows approved scripts, workflows, SOPs, job aids, privacy requirements, and quality standards while balancing patient-centered service with daily performance expectations. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home across US time zones. The wage for this position is: $24.52 USD per hour. This range represents the expected base pay for the role across all U.S. locations, based on market data and internal benchmarking. Aledade offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes a company bonus, equity, 401k match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. A full review of our total rewards package will be discussed at the offer stage with the selected candidate.

jobs.title: Payer Operations Analyst
jobs.description_text: The Payer Data Operations Analyst ensures data quality, accuracy, and reliability across payer data pipelines to support value-based contract performance. This role applies technical data skills and cross-functional leadership to resolve complex data issues, build proactive monitoring solutions, and partner with internal teams and payers to continuously enhance end-to-end data integrity.

jobs.title: Practice Transformation Specialist, Florida Panhandle
jobs.description_text: Join Aledade as a Practice Transformation Specialist (PTS) for our Florida practices and personally make an impact on patient care. Practice Transformation Specialists are HQ’s most direct interface with providers and can glean valuable insight into our partner practice’s happiness and needs. A successful PTS is passionate about population health, and highly mission oriented around providing better care to patients while reducing costs. At Aledade, a PTS can impact the health of their community by transforming one practice at a time. Please note: candidates must be based in Florida to be considered. Note on Travel: This is primarily a remote role, but on-site check-ins are key. You can expect to travel in-person approximately 1x per month per practice. Exact schedules flex based on practice needs, meaning some months may be lighter or heavier than others. Salary Range: $65,000-$75,000 base + bonuses + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Program Specialist, CMMI Programs
jobs.description_text: Reporting directly to the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Innovation (CMMI) Program Manager, the Program Specialist will be a pivotal contributor to the operational excellence and strategic growth of our CMMI initiatives. This role is responsible for the intricate management and refinement of core program processes, ensuring seamless execution across all facets of CMMI models (LEAD & REACH). The Specialist will play a key role in analyzing program performance, identifying opportunities for optimization, and collaborating with diverse internal teams to implement innovative solutions that enhance engagement and outcomes within the CMMI model framework. This position is central to translating strategic vision into operational reality, driving the continuous improvement and successful scaling of CMMI models. Candidates should be comfortable working remotely from anywhere within the US, across all US time zones. Salary Range: $80,000—$92,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Project Manager / Senior Project Manager
jobs.description_text: At BioAgilytix, we are passionate about premier science and the impact it has on our world. Our team of highly experienced scientists and professionals deliver tailored services for supporting new medicine breakthroughs with best-in-class bioanalytical services. We are tirelessly committed to our customers by being solution-oriented and deadline-driven. . . and we are growing. Our culture is fast-paced, fun and never boring. Because we work across numerous clients and drug modalities, your career can develop rapidly. You’ll gain experience with a variety of challenges all while you enable life-changing, life-saving therapeutics to the patients who need them. Energy Vault’s focus is to deliver reliable, flexible power that supports the evolving needs of modern grids, communities, and large energy users.
